name: 3 Nights of Terror
storyline:
Scott Harris is a dedicated police officer at the local Rockville Police Department. Lately, his toughest fight has begun in his own mind. He suffers from severe Parasomnia, a sleep disorder that leaves him exhausted in terrifying nightmares.

His hope lies in an experimental brain surgery scheduled in three days. This is his last chance to reclaim control over his mind and escape the horrifying nightmares that plague him. Until then, Harris has to endure three more nights of pure terror.

Every time Harris falls asleep, he is trapped in strange and terrifying dreams. The only thing guiding him is his blurry memories of police work, pushing him to keep going and find answers. But with each night, the nightmares feel more real, and the line between dream and reality starts to disappear.

Who can he trust when even his own mind turns against him? Let’s guide him in the psychological horror nightmares and ensure he wakes up in the morning!
summary: 3 Nights of Terror lets you dive into the Nightmare-driven Dreams of Police Officer Scott Harris, who suffers from an extreme form of Parasomnia. Guide him through his horrifying dreams and survive the Nightmares to ensure he wakes up in the morning.
